senses.gloss:
कोक कोक, m.
 1. A wolf, Rām. 5, 26, 9.
 2. The cuckoo (ved.).
 3. The ruddy goose, Gīt. 5, 17.
 --Cf. Lat. cuculus.

कोकनद कोकनदअ,
 I. n. The red lotus, Gīt. 10, 5.
 II. m. pl. The name of a people, MBh. 2, 1026.

कोकिल कोकिल, i. e. कोक + इल, m.
 1. The Indian cuckoo, Rām. 2, 52, 2. f. ला, The female cuckoo, Bhartṛ. 1, 34.
 2. A kind of mouse, Suśr. 2, 274, 4.
 3. A poisonous insect. Suśr. 2, 288, 7.
 --Comp.
